title: Preparation of 3.7% Paraformaldehyde Solution
author: Institute of Medical Biotechnology
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcfpitmn
materials: For 1 L, 3.7% Formaldehyde, add 800 mL, 1X DPBS to a glass beaker on a stir plate. Be sure to work under a ventilated fume hood.

steps.title: Prepare DPBS base solution
steps.instruction: In a glass beaker placed on a stir plate inside a ventilated fume hood, add 800 mL of 1X DPBS (for a final 1 L, 3.7 % formaldehyde solution).

steps.title: Heat DPBS solution
steps.instruction: Stir the DPBS and heat to approximately 55 °C while maintaining stirring.

steps.title: Add paraformaldehyde powder
steps.instruction: Add 37 g of paraformaldehyde powder to the heated DPBS solution.

steps.title: Dissolve PFA and adjust pH
steps.instruction: Continue stirring until the powder is completely dissolved, ensuring the solution does not boil; if dissolution is slow, add NaOH one drop at a time. Once fully dissolved, adjust the pH to 7.4 with HCl.

substeps.instruction: Stir until all PFA is dissolved, avoiding boiling.
Add NaOH dropwise (one drop at a time) if needed for solubility.

steps.title: Bring to final volume
steps.instruction: Add additional 1X DPBS until the total solution volume reaches 1 L.

steps.title: Aliquot and store
steps.instruction: Transfer the finished 3.7 % paraformaldehyde solution into tubes of the desired proportions and store at –20 °C until use.
